run_rmsnorm_hf: run the rmsnorm_hf function to apply HuggingFace-style RMS normalization on a 2D fp16 or bf16 tensor
check_is_supported_rmsnorm_hf_hidden_siz: check if a given hidden size is supported by the JIT rmsnorm_hf kernel for warp or CTA launch configs
build_rmsnorm_hf_kernel: build a JIT-compiled CUDA RMSNorm kernel module using the HFRMSNormWarpKernel or HFRMSNormKernel class
test_rmsnorm_hf: test the rmsnorm_hf function with a 2D bfloat16 tensor of shape num_tokens by hidden_size
review_is_supported_rmsnorm_hf_hidden_si: review the is_supported_rmsnorm_hf_hidden_size function to understand warp and CTA block size constraints
